newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - May 2.
newsitem.headline: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - May 2.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Malaysian stocks on Friday:
* On Wall Street, the Dow Jones industrial average slipped 32.51 points to 6,976.48 on Thursday.

* Malaysian markets were closed on Thursday for Labour Day. On Wednesday, the Malaysian blue-chip Composite Index rebounded 20.66 points to 1,080.17, helped by a rise in utility Tenaga Nasional, which was granted an 8.3 percent tariff increase.
* Ringgit stuck in a range on Thursday in thin trading. At 0300 GMT on Thursday, it was at 2.5101/11 to a dollar.
* Tenaga's stock could rise up to 12 ringgit, said Ralph Dixon, of TA Securities' international division. The shares ended on Wednesday at 11.60 ringgit.
Analysts expect the tariff boost to add 300-400 million ringgit to the utility's 1998 earnings.
* But any continued stock market rise may be hampered by sidelined investors, Dixon said. "Funds don't seem to have been mobilised by the fall (in share prices)."
* In other news, Johan Holdings Bhd posted year net income of 33.82 million ringgit versus 33.12 million a year ago.
* Tenggara Capital Bhd posted 17.42 million ringgit in net profits for the year versus 17.34 million.
